trial.title: Treat as trial until subscription starts
trial.desc: If Subscription Start Date is in the future, the account is in trial until then. Trial length = days until subscription start (e.g., 20 days if start is 20 days from today).

activateNow.title: Activate subscription now
activateNow.descOn: A subscription invoice will be generated immediately for the plan below.
activateNow.descOff: No invoice will be generated. Use for hardware-only or placeholder accounts. You can activate later by editing this account.

upgradeGuide.title: Upgrade and it adds up for you
upgradeGuide.lead: Your current plan covers supplier ordering and purchase invoices at no cost. Add stock and recipes, and what you order flows straight into stock levels and menu cost.
upgradeGuide.leadIncluded: Your plan already includes stock and recipes. Open them from the menu on the left.
upgradeGuide.stockBody: Record what arrives and the remaining quantity goes up on its own, then down as you sell. No separate counting.
upgradeGuide.recipeTitle: Cost per dish is worked out
upgradeGuide.recipeBody: Link ingredients to a recipe, and when a supplier price changes the menu cost changes with it.
upgradeGuide.supplierTitle: Compare supplier prices side by side
upgradeGuide.supplierBody: When the same ingredient comes from several suppliers, you can see who is cheaper and when a price went up.
upgradeGuide.keep: Your existing orders and supplier details stay exactly as they are. Nothing to re-enter.
